'''Edward Bentley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[February 2002 Littlehampton tournament]] on 24 February 2002, according to Chris Seymour's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3400">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-littlehampton-24-2-02-sealed-deckd3400/ littlehampton-24-2-02-sealed-deck], DeckTech (Chris "vader69" Seymour, 25 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-littlehampton-24-2-02-sealed-deckd3400/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
